# `base/value-inputs`

A single typed value needs a specialised editor — colour, datetime, phone, slider or tags.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A single typed value needs a specialised editor — colour, datetime, phone, slider or tags.
- **Avoid when:** The value is plain text or a number with a unit.
- **Consider instead:** `base/text-inputs`, `base/forms-numeric`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { ColorInput } from "themelia-ui/base/value-inputs"
import "themelia-ui/base/value-inputs.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/choice-inputs`, `base/date-pickers`, `base/display`, `base/structure`, `base/text-inputs`, `base/typography`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.
